stem: Why did the “Return to Normalcy” agenda of U.S. presidential candidate Warren G. Harding appeal to many voters in the 1920 election?

options.label: F
options.text: The public wanted to help rebuild war-torn countries.

options.label: G
options.text: There were significant shortages of military supplies.

options.label: H
options.text: There was a decrease in demand for consumer goods.

options.label: J
options.text: The public wanted to concentrate on domestic economic issues.
